rules.summary: A setting differs from what the policy requires
rules.explanation: The organisation's policy fixes this setting. The build cannot change it; ask the owners of the policy instead.

rules.summary: A setting is weaker than the policy allows
rules.explanation: The policy sets the weakest value this setting may have. A stricter value is fine, a weaker one is not.

rules.summary: An ignore rule has no expiry, which the policy demands
rules.explanation: Every accepted finding has to be looked at again. Give the rule an expires date.

rules.summary: An ignore rule lasts longer than the policy allows
rules.explanation: The policy limits how far ahead an ignore rule may expire.

rules.summary: The build uses a module the policy denies
rules.explanation: The organisation's policy forbids this module, directly or transitively.
